stations.name: Workbench
stations.role: Wood, bindings and all live-capture traps.

stations.name: Pantry
stations.role: Milk and fruit preparation; a processing station, not an Energy-consuming generator.

stations.name: Kiln
stations.role: Small fired-clay components; consider merging into an existing station when selecting live content.

phases.name: Starter loop
phases.focus: Existing wheat, eggs and Water make biscuits; existing softwood makes a simple wooden trap. Catch common land Wildlings before adding resource families.

phases.name: Habitat branches
phases.focus: Add fruit/herb/seed baits and shore resources. First broad habitat affinities; no dependency on exact rare POIs.

phases.name: Specialist tools
phases.focus: Sugar, cookies, rope and hardware unlock aquatic/large-species tools. New station unlock pacing remains undesigned.

phases.name: Night discoveries
phases.focus: Mooncaps, luminous bait and lantern traps create an optional night branch. Weather/seasons remain disabled extensions.

invariants: All new quantities, durations, tiers, names and station assignments are proposals, not approved balance.
Existing flour, biscuit and Berry tonic recipes are copied unchanged from crafting-v1.json.
Raw wood and crop collection stay in the world. No home wood/crop production is introduced.
Crafting is controlled by time and queue capacity, with no operating Energy cost. A recipe may explicitly consume Energy as an ingredient.
Current map chicken/cow gatherers provide one egg/milk per animal and are not captured Wildling species.
Future home animal/water generation is separate: it uses Energy and produces nontradable resources. That system is not implemented by this proposal.
No caught Wildling, animal body or harvested creature is consumed as a crafting ingredient.
Do not infer that crafting a more expensive item guarantees a catch or makes all earlier bait obsolete.
Species eligibility is separate from weighted selection and the success roll. Habitat suitability can change relative species selection without promising success.
Addressable paths remain null until approved art is imported and registered; catalog IDs are independent of vendor filenames.
designQuestions: Whether different trap types exclude creature size categories or merely improve chances.
How far a shore band extends in meters and how to handle ambiguous/coarse water geometry.
Whether home-origin nontradable inputs make the whole crafted output nontradable; choose before that generator system ships.
Whether Sugar can also come from berries; this draft chooses sugarcane to keep the first tree legible.
The proposed Pantry/Loom/Forge can be consolidated if too many buildings make progression busy.
Which proposed products should enter runtime first, and which station proposals should be consolidated?
Fast Grow Tonic still needs quantities, station, time, level, target and effect before it can become a recipe.

worldMaterialVisibilityDirection.rule: Show all currently collectible material tiers plus exactly the next tier. Higher-tier interaction uses Level <n> required.
worldMaterialVisibilityDirection.harvestSuccessAndMaterialSkill: Discussion only. No level-based success RNG or per-material skill progression is adopted by this proposal.
separateMechanics: Private flock/herd yields remain one item per animal.
Water and Energy remain POI pickups with saved cooldowns; Energy is classified as currency and may be an explicit recipe ingredient.

conceptRecipes.status: Ingredient concept only; does not activate resource regrowth or Home crop production.
